segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin generally find the oil absorbs without clogging pores, though several — including some who liked the product — note it can feel a bit rich and may need blotting or setting powder by midday, and one reviewer says other Coola products suit oily skin better.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry, including very dry, skin describe the oil as replenishing and comfortable for daily use, with only one dry-skinned reviewer, using it in winter, finding it sits too heavy.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin say it soaks in without greasiness and works well layered under or instead of a moisturizer, though one would skip it on very hot days.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers who describe their skin as sensitive, including some with reactive or acne-prone sensitive skin, consistently report no irritation and a gentle feel, with one reviewer cautioning that the fragrance might not suit sensitive skin.
segments.normal: The reviewers with normal skin say it absorbs fully despite initial worry about oiliness, leaving skin soft without residue.
segments.mature: Reviewers with mature skin credit the oil with a plumper, more radiant look and, in some cases, softened fine lines, though one in her 60s says she hasn't noticed a drastic firming effect despite smoother, better-moisturized skin.

concerns.aging: Reviewers using the oil for its firming claim report subtle results building over consistent use — smoother texture, reduced fine lines, some plumping — usually noticeable after one to several weeks; a few reviewers, including a 25-year-old with only minor lines, say they could not detect any firming effect.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers with dry skin, including through winter conditions, report the oil restores hydration and leaves skin plump rather than tight; one reviewer notes that very dry skin may still need a separate moisturizer layered underneath, especially in winter.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with very dry skin reports the oil reduced redness and irritation on her skin; no other reviewer in this set specifically addresses redness.
concerns.barrier: Several reviewers cite the vitamin C, D and E content and describe the oil as supporting or 'locking in' the skin's moisture barrier, reporting a more nourished, protected feel; no reviewer reports the opposite.
concerns.spots: One reviewer with hyperpigmentation reports her skin tone looking more even after use; another mentions the bakuchiol ingredient is formulated to target the appearance of dark spots, without confirming a personal result.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers, including several who describe themselves as acne-prone, report no new breakouts and credit the non-comedogenic formula; two dissent — one 3-star reviewer says it clogged her pores, and another reports a few temporary bumps in the first two days that cleared by day three.
concerns.oiliness: Several critical reviewers report the oil never fully absorbs and leaves a lasting greasy film, particularly compared to the brand's body oil; reviewers who like the product still frequently caveat that very oily skin may find it rich and need blotting, while others with oily skin report no added shine or clogged pores.

extraits.texte: I must say I was very excited to try this product just thinking that it had multiple steps and multiple benefits in one product had me very intrigued. The concept and the ingredients are great but after using it for a week I must say that although my skin is dry and we are still in winter, it feels very heavy on the skin to use daily, the texture of the oil is light but when it settles on the skin it feels very very heavy, it is not sticky, it is just heavy. The finish it leaves is like any other oil, another thing I noticed is that the aroma is a little strong, it has a similarity to beach products which for me was a little strong for daily use. The package is pretty so aesthetic and safe, the dropper is really good too. I would definitely give it another use for days Beach, pool or outdoor activities. **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

extraits.titre: Love this as an oily skin girly
extraits.texte: I have super oily skin and usually avoid anything labeled as a "face oil," but I gave Coola's Firming Face Oil SPF 30 a shot, and honestly, it's better than I expected. It feels a little rich at first, but after a few minutes, it sinks in and leaves my skin looking glowy—not greasy. No white cast, no weird film, and it layers under makeup without getting patchy. That said, if you have really oily skin, you'll probably need to blot or set it with powder. By midday, my T-zone got shiny, but it never felt heavy or clogged my pores, which is a win. It's definitely not a matte sunscreen, so if you hate any shine, this might not be for you. But if you like that fresh, hydrated look, it's actually really nice. I also love that it's packed with good-for-your-skin ingredients and is reef-safe. It's a little pricey, but for an SPF that doesn't make me look like a ghost or break me out, I'd say it's worth it. I'll keep using it, especially on days when I want that healthy, natural glow.

The Coola Firming Face Oil SPF 30 has becoming my new favorite face oil. I have really sensitive skin, and what I love about this product is that it has helped to reduce the small fine lines I had on my face. This product also has Vitamin C, D, and E. This product is also organic, and cruelty free. I spend a lot of time at work using my two computer monitors at phone. This product has BlueScreen Digital De-Stress Technology mitigates the effects of blue light and environmental stressors. I highly recommend using this product. I skin is glowing, and looks very hydrated and glowing. A little goes a long way, and I use this product twice a day, in the morning and evening. This product is also vegan and cruelty free. I also have hyperpigmentation and after using this product my skin tone is looking more even. **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

extraits.titre: Glowing Skin With Face Oil Sunscreen
extraits.texte: As a beauty enthusiast in my early 60s, I love finding products to keep my aging skin looking radiant. And I love a good face oil! The Coola Firming Face Oil Sunscreen feels wonderful on the skin. It applies beautifully, whether worn alone or under makeup, and it layers well without making my skin feel greasy. I like that it's unscented and formulated with plant-powered Retinol plus BlueScreen Digital Di-Stress Technology, which makes me love it even more. The dropper applicator allows for precise application. I can cover my face and neck with just a few drops. It absorbs quickly, leaving a soft, hydrated finish without feeling heavy or oily. My skin feels nourished, and I love that it adds a healthy glow. Unlike some facial sunscreens, it doesn't pill or leave a white cast, making it perfect for everyday wear. So far, I haven't noticed a drastic firming effect, but my skin feels smooth and well-moisturized throughout the day. This is a great option if you are looking for a skincare-infused sunscreen that hydrates and protects without weighing down the skin. **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

extraits.titre: Absolute game changer for skin care and sunscreen!
extraits.texte: I am absolutely obsessed with this firming face oil with SPF 30. This firming face oil is farm to face, antioxidant enriched, cruelty, free, vegan, and dermatologic tested. It also contains bakuchiol extract, which is a plant based retinol, that smooths the look of fine lines and helps with collagen production. Amazing! It also contains vitamins C, D, and E. There are so many added benefits to this product - the list goes on and on.I have normal skin, and at first, I was concerned that this would make my skin really oily and makeup would not apply over it. I was wrong. My skin absorbed it so well, and makeup was not an issue. My skin never appeared oily, even after wearing it an entire day.Sunscreen is so important, not just on sunny days, but everyday, to prevent damage from sum and harsh lights.Cools hit it out of the park with this game changer. I rarely give 5 stars, but honestly, this one deserves 10!!! **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

Not only does this product help to protect my skin from the sun, I have experienced no breakouts from using this oil on my skin. As someone who have incredibly sensitive acne prone skin, I get nervous when I hear the word oil. I decided to take the chance and use this face oil on my recent vacation. I am very fair in complexion, which means I will burn fast in the sun. I reapplied this oil every three hours and did not receive any sunburn on my face. Additionally, the product was easy to remove at the end of the day with an oil based makeup remover.
